versions.changelog: 更新检索流程和交互逻辑

- Initial release of the 知网博士学位论文检索工具.
- Automates CNKI advanced search to find and export top 5 (by citation) doctoral dissertations matching a given topic.
- Supports export in 查新（引文格式）Word document for further analysis.
- Handles user guidance through verification steps and provides clear progress updates.
- Automatically renames and reports the saved file location to the user for seamless workflow integration.
